title: TOA Project Structure
description: How the TOA codebase is organized
content: The TOA project uses a modular architecture with separate backend (FastAPI) and frontend (Next.js) folders. The backend handles RAG processing with ChromaDB, while the frontend provides a chat interface. Vector embeddings are stored in chrome_langchain_db directory.

title: TOA RAG Pipeline
content: TOA uses a custom RAG pipeline where documents are chunked, embedded with mxbai-embed-large model, and stored in ChromaDB. Queries retrieve top 5 most relevant chunks which are passed to Llama 3.2 for context-aware responses.

title: TOA API Endpoints
description: Custom API routes for the copilot
content: TOA FastAPI backend exposes /chat for AI responses, /health for status checks, and /upload for future file processing. All responses include source attribution from the vector database.

title: TOA Context Window
description: How context is managed in TOA
content: TOA uses a sliding context window of 5 previous messages. Each user query retrieves fresh context from the vector store to ensure up-to-date information without hallucination from old conversations.

title: TOA Error Handling
content: TOA implements custom error handling for Ollama connection issues, ChromaDB failures, and malformed user inputs. Errors are gracefully handled with user-friendly messages in the frontend.

title: TOA Model Configuration
content: TOA is configured with Llama 3.2 for chat responses and mxbai-embed-large for embeddings. Temperature is set to 0.1 for consistent responses, and top-p is 0.9 for creativity balance.

title: TOA Deployment Setup
content: To run TOA: 1) Start backend with 'python main.py', 2) Start frontend with 'npm run dev', 3) Ensure Ollama is running with required models. Backend runs on port 8000, frontend on port 3000.
example: cd backend && python main.py\ncd frontend && npm run dev

title: TOA Vector Search
content: TOA uses cosine similarity with ChromaDB to find relevant documents. The retriever fetches top 5 matches based on semantic similarity to the user query for optimal context retrieval.

title: TOA Prompt Engineering
content: TOA uses carefully engineered prompts that include context placeholders and specific instructions for the model to base responses on retrieved documents rather than general knowledge.

title: TOA Session Management
content: TOA maintains session state through conversation IDs. Each chat session preserves context separately, allowing multiple users or topics without interference between conversations.
